{{Quote|Renei and Wunana both died only three years later in the Twenty-Second Battle of Zehava. They were barely older than me.|Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="JA" />}}
'''Wunana''' was a member of the [[Melida/Legends|Melida]] people of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Melida/Daan/Legends|Melida/Daan]]. Their [[Parent/Legends|parents]], [[Quintama]] and [[Pinani]], were both [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the Melida's conflict with the [[Daan (people)/Legends|Daan]] people. By [[49 BBY/Legends|49 BBY]], Wunana and their sibling [[Renei]] were killed in the [[Twenty-Second Battle of Zehava]]. In [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] saw a marker noting Wunana's death in a [[Hall of Evidence]] mausoleum.

==Biography==
{{Quote|My children, Renei and Wunana, I leave the memory of the ancestors I have shared with them, the stories of our long persecution by the Daan.|Quintama, in a hologram message|<ref name="JA" />}}
[[File:Obi-Wan-Defenders_of_the_Dead_cover.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Obi-Wan Kenobi (pictured) viewed holograms mentioning Wunana in a Hall of Evidence.]]
Wunana was a member of the [[Melida/Legends|Melida]] people who inhabited the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Melida/Daan/Legends|Melida/Daan]]. They had a sibling, [[Renei]], and were the child of the [[Melida Liberation Force]] members [[Quintama]] and [[Pinani]]. They were the grandchild of [[Quintama's father]] and Pinani's [[Parent/Legends|parents]], the Melida heroes [[Bicha]] and [[Tiraca]]. Prior to his [[Death/Legends|death]] in the [[Twenty-First Battle of Zehava]], which was part of the Melida's [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] long conflict with the [[Daan (people)/Legends|Daan]] people, Quintama recorded a [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] message in which he reminded Wunana and Renei of his family's suffering at the hands of the Daan. Later, Pinani recorded another message before an [[Battle of Bin|attack]] on the [[City/Legends|town]] of [[Bin]] in which she asked Wunana and Renei to remember and avenge her. Three [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later,<ref name="JA" /> by [[49 BBY/Legends|49 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> Wunana and Renei were both killed in the [[Twenty-Second Battle of Zehava]].<ref name="JA" />

The messages from Wunana's parents mentioning them and a marker noting their death were kept in a Melida [[Hall of Evidence]] mausoleum.<ref name="JA" /> In [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> while in the Hall of Evidence, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] saw the messages and marker, with the thirteen-year-old Kenobi noting that Wunana and Renei had been barely older than he was when they died.<ref name="JA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Wunana was mentioned in ''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Defenders of the Dead]]'', a [[1999]] young-readers novel written by [[Jude Watson]] as the fifth entry in the ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Apprentice]]'' series.<ref name="JA" />
